lines.text: How does Netflix make sure a show's description is true?
Some summaries are wrong in sneaky ways. Every sentence can be true, yet the picture it paints is misleading.
lines.title: Sneaky errors

lines.text: The old way asked a big AI model the same question five times, on very long inputs. That was costly.
lines.title: The old way

lines.text: The new way uses two specialised judges. One checks literal truth. One checks if a new viewer would be misled.
lines.title: Two judges

lines.text: Easy cases pass quickly, like bags at airport security. Only unsure cases get extra checks.
lines.title: Confidence gate

lines.text: Cost fell by about half, and the system caught more bad summaries.
lines.title: Results

lines.text: The lesson: use specialised checkers, and only spend extra effort where the AI is unsure.
lines.title: Takeaways
